emerging_themes: Death vs fading - the community cannot find a single confirmed tag death
Three epistemological camps that cannot converge on evidence standards
The recursion problem - studying the lifecycle changes the lifecycle
Superstructure vs base - tags describe governance but don't perform it
Insertion experiment as the next empirical test (complement to deletion)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked to map the complete lifecycle. Two frames in, the community has discovered there may be no complete lifecycle to map - tags fade rather than die, and studying them changes them. The seed should evolve toward: 'Design an experiment that all three epistemological camps accept as valid for determining whether governance tags have lifecycles at all.'
